features.name: Multi-Step Checkout Process
features.description: Streamlined, guided booking workflow from vehicle selection to confirmation with clear progress indication. Includes 6 checkout steps: Vehicle Selection, Customer Information, Additional Options, Payment Method, Review & Confirm, and Confirmation.
features.stakeholder_benefit: Clear, guided process reduces booking abandonment and errors. Progress indicators set expectations and reduce anxiety.

features.name: Persona-Based Booking Experience
features.description: Dynamic booking interface that adapts to user segment (Power Renter, Experience Seeker, Young Driver, Eco-Conscious, Accessible Mobility), surfacing relevant options and streamlining the flow based on user type.
features.stakeholder_benefit: Tailored experience reduces friction for each user type. Power renters book faster, luxury customers get assurance, budget users see relevant options.

google_form_question.title: F-BM-002: Persona-Based Booking Experience
google_form_question.description: Dynamic interface adapting to user segments (Power Renter, Experience Seeker, Young Driver, Eco-Conscious, Accessible Mobility)

features.name: Voice-Activated Booking
features.description: Complete booking flow executable through voice commands for hands-free operation. Integration with Alexa Automotive, Android Auto, and Siri.
features.stakeholder_benefit: Drivers can book while driving safely. Accessibility benefit for visually impaired users. Speed and convenience for power users.

features.name: Flexible Pricing Mode Selection
features.description: Multiple pricing models (Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Per-Kilometer, Unlimited Mileage, Hybrid) with real-time price calculation and dynamic pricing display.
features.stakeholder_benefit: Customers choose pricing that matches their usage pattern. Transparency builds trust and reduces disputes.

features.name: Discount Code & Promotion Application
features.description: Apply promotional codes, corporate discounts, and loyalty rewards during booking with real-time validation and calculation.
features.stakeholder_benefit: Customers access available discounts easily. Transparent pricing with clear savings display.

ai_analysis_notes.extraction_approach: The AI reads the markdown file and identifies structured feature definitions (F-BM-XXX codes). Each feature is extracted with its ID, name, description, priority, capabilities, and stakeholder benefits.
ai_analysis_notes.dependency_detection: Dependencies are inferred from feature relationships - for example, F-BM-002 (Persona-Based) depends on F-BM-001 (Multi-Step Checkout) as the base booking flow.
ai_analysis_notes.google_form_mapping: Each feature becomes ONE question. All questions use the same 4 options defined in output/google-form-options-schema.json
ai_analysis_notes.options_schema_reference: output/google-form-options-schema.json contains the standard 4 options used by all questions
ai_analysis_notes.description_usage: Question descriptions are only added for complex or ambiguous features. Simple features have empty descriptions to keep the form clean.
ai_analysis_notes.analysis_decoding: During analysis, the AI uses team votes to determine: (a) Which features go in MVP, (b) Which features go in Phase 2/3, (c) Which features are excluded entirely
ai_analysis_notes.question_reduction: 17 features = 17 questions (not 51). All questions share the same 4 options.
ai_analysis_notes.categorization: Features are grouped by their section headings in the markdown (Booking Creation, Modifications, etc.) which become form sections.
ai_analysis_notes.output_format: JSON only - contains feature metadata, source file references, and dependency tree for analysis phase lookup.
